description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹財務金融領域中建構風險管理模型的工具、方法及其應用，講述如何利用數學模型對金融衍生性商品進行理論定價、如何模擬資產價格、如何利用金融市場的隱含資訊校準模型以及如何利用數學模型分析金融市場。
description.describe_eh: This course introduce basic concepts, stochastic models, and the application for constructing financial models to manage financial risks. The contents involve: How to evaluate theoretical prices of financial derivatives with dynamic models; How to simulate asset prices; How to calibrate models with the implied information in financial market and (4) How to analyze the financial market based on models.

targets.describe_en: Application for the mathematical model to  evaluate the theoretical price of financial derivatives
